links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4o versus UpToDate acute appendicitis responses (word counts, difficult words, FRE, FKGL, SMOG)
links.effect: ChatGPT had a lower difficult-word count (p = 0.002) but a higher difficult-word percentage (p = 0.002); FRE, FKGL, SMOG and sentence count did not differ significantly (all p > 0.05).
links.quote: ChatGPT had a lower absolute difficult-word count (p = 0.002) but a higher difficult-word percentage (p = 0.002).

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability of ChatGPT-4o responses to medical queries compared to UpToDate without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
